what_this_is: The hand-audit of PREREGISTRATION.md §4. 60 entries drawn from the held-out half with seed 20260908, read one by one. label 1 = the text states something about the named work that a reader could use; label 0 = it does not. These labels are this practice's own reading. They are published as labels with their rule, never as ground truth about the works, and every one can be checked against the live feed.
rule_as_applied: label 0 when, after reading the value in full, I could not say what the work does from this text alone.
correction_2026-09-08: Entry n=5 was recorded as 'Brain Processing Unit – The Future Where Biology and Semiconductors Merge'. The drawn entry is 'Brain Processing Unit – The Future Where Biology and Computer Integrate'. The title was typed from a display truncated at 52 characters, so the subtitle was invented; the label itself was made against the correct entry's text and does not change. Found by the convened adversary. Title corrected here and the matcher in audit.py and check.py tightened from a 40-character prefix to an exact match, so this class of divergence now fails the build instead of passing it.
